name: Kappa benchmark
description: A frozen 100-entry Ancient Greek–English Kappa corpus from Stephanos of Byzantium's Ethnika, with approved reference translations and 4,500 recorded model outputs. The benchmark has three prompt versions used across 15 model profiles (12 OpenAI and three Anthropic). Every model profile was evaluated with every prompt version on all 100 entries. The dataset includes the Greek source texts, approved English references, recorded model translations with their settings and per-translation reference-similarity scores, the three prompt texts, a CSV recording the Gabe-rule guidance supplied for each passage and model run, and the complete 180-record Gabe-rules register in CSV and an editable Word reading copy. The guidance CSV retains the wording associated with each run; the release-time register describes the rules at release. The Greek text supplied to the models is preserved. For the documented source-character defect in κ75, a separate corrected-source field is checked against the 1849 edition. The corpus is an operational sample, not a random sample of the work. Reference-similarity scores are not calibrated measures of philological correctness. Released with author approval under CC BY-NC 4.0.
